{{Quote|From the look of the vapor trails, I'm thinking Merr-Sonn MX-2s. That's stolen Republic ordnance! They're using our own weapons against us.|Commander [[Bragan]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''MX-2''' was a model of surface-to-air [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] developed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and used during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] used those launchers on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], where some of the ordnance was stolen by the local separatists to be used against the Republic.
